remarks: Discover this exceptional 2,229 sq. ft. custom-built home by Art Homes, featuring a striking open-to-below design, large windows that flood the home with natural light, and an airy, open-concept layout that creates a bright and spacious feel throughout. The main floor offers a bedroom and full bathroom, along with a separate spice kitchen, perfect for modern family living and entertaining. Upstairs, enjoy a spacious bonus room and three bedrooms, including a stunning primary retreat with a vaulted ceiling and oversized walk-in closet. Complete with an attached double garage and a backyard with no rear neighbours, backing directly onto a walking trail, this home offers the perfect blend of space, style, and privacy. Photos are representative. (id:67522)
